summary: A large, fortress-like structure built primarily of stone bricks. It features a U-shaped main building with a central courtyard, flanked by four tall, square watchtowers at the outer corners. The roofs are flat, topped with a dark red material and bordered by stone slabs, with glowstone used for illumination.

shape.overall_form: tiered blocky structure with corner towers

rebuild_hints: Lay out the U-shaped footprint first, leaving the central courtyard open.
Construct the four square watchtowers at the corners, ensuring they extend significantly higher than the main building.
Build the main walls with a tiered approach, stepping the structure inward on higher levels.
Cap the flat roofs with a dark red block and border them with stone slabs.
Add an overhanging cap to each tower using stone slabs.
Place glowstone blocks symmetrically on the roof and above the main entrance for lighting.
uncertainties: Interior layout and floor divisions are completely unknown.
The exact block type of the dark red roof material (netherrack vs nether brick) is uncertain.
Exact block dimensions are estimated from visual proportions.
